answers.goal: I want to work in entertainment marketing

answers.seeking: I’m open to connect with people from all parts of the industry, but I’m particularly interested in music marketing.
answers.inspiration: Selena Gomez because she manages to overcome mental health struggles and the public eye to still remain true to her values and building a lasting legacy.
answers.favorite: Game of Thrones, Bone and All
